name: Valcom Inc.
old_description: Designed and built in the USA since 1977 and backed by 24/7 support.
about:
Valcom Inc. was founded in 1977 in Roanoke, Virginia, where it remains headquartered. The company began with a focus on helping organizations communicate easily with their people, a mission that has evolved over more than four decades into a broader vision of keeping communities safe, informed, and on schedule.

Valcom designs and develops telecommunication systems, paging solutions, emergency notification platforms, and visual messaging solutions. All hardware is designed and assembled in-house, giving the company direct control over quality and the ability to pivot quickly. Proprietary software platforms such as VEMASS and VEEWS support system reliability and survivability. The company has deployed more than 44,000 K-12 communications systems, including for the Los Angeles Unified School District, the second-largest public school district in the United States.

Valcom serves K-12 and higher education, commercial and industrial facilities, healthcare, corporate campuses, transportation, government and military installations, and retail markets. Its solutions are engineered to integrate with existing infrastructure, and the company provides guidance on grant funding for emergency response upgrades. Customers include school districts, hospitals, and federal agencies.

The company emphasizes that its U.S.-based design and assembly, 24/7 technical support, and scalable architecture differentiate it from competitors. Valcom also allows customers to choose their own installers and integrators, and its grant assistance program helps organizations secure funding for safety improvements.

name: Valentine Enterprises Inc
old_description: Valentine Enterprises specializes in custom powder formulation, blending, and packaging. Combining Scientific Expertise with high-quality manufacturing, Valentine brings your product vision to life.
about:
Valentine Enterprises operates a 400,000-square-foot, company-owned facility in Lawrenceville, Georgia, where it provides contract manufacturing services for powder-based nutritional products.

The company’s core services span product development, ingredient sourcing, validated mixing, and precision packaging. Its formulators and scientists work with brands to create or refine powder supplements, including protein powders, vitamins, and nutritional blends. Manufacturing follows straight-line precision processes under cGMP and HACCP standards, with allergen-controlled protocols and rigorous cleaning procedures. The facility supports turnkey projects that manage development, sourcing, production, and quality assurance from concept to finished goods.

Valentine serves brands in the dietary supplement, sports nutrition, and wellness markets. Its client base includes Fortune 100 and Fortune 500 companies as well as large protein-powder sellers. The company emphasizes proprietary, customer-specific formulations rather than private-label offerings, though it notes it is exploring private-label solutions.

Valentine differentiates itself through a set of core values that prioritize personal quality ownership, ethical decision-making, rapid response times, and commitment adherence. It also highlights its certification portfolio—NSF, cGMP, Organic, Kosher, HACCP, and FDA registration—as evidence of going beyond industry standards. Flavor development is cited as a particular passion and specialty.

name: Valley Fabrication, Inc.
old_description: Serving North Central Illinois since 1973.  Our experience in Industrial Fabrication is unmatched.
about:
Valley Fabrication, Inc. was founded in 1973 in La Salle, Illinois. The company operates as a sister concern to Machinery Maintenance, Inc. and On Site Repair Services, Inc., serving Central Illinois from its La Salle base.

The shop provides full-service metal fabrication, including custom weldments, tank and structural steel fabrication, transition and ductwork pieces, stairs, platforms, and conveyor replacement parts. Its welding capabilities cover MIG, TIG, submerged arc, and exotic alloy welding (aluminum, stainless steel, Monel), with steel cutting up to 6 inches and plasma cutting up to 2 inches. An in-house American Welding Society (AWS) certified training facility runs an apprenticeship program led by a certified instructor.

Valley Fabrication primarily serves industrial maintenance and heavy-equipment sectors in North Central Illinois, repairing buckets, cutting edges, bores, shafts, and wear surfaces for loaders, excavators, dozers, and shovels, as well as screw conveyor flighting, crushers, screeners, and shakers. Its customer base spans cities such as LaSalle, Peru, Ottawa, Spring Valley, Rockford, and Bloomington.

The company emphasizes an AWS-certified workforce, ongoing OSHA safety training, and a mission to deliver the highest value materials and services in the most timely manner. Its apprenticeship program and certified weld inspections are cited as key differentiators.

name: Valley Steel Services
old_description: Providing steel to Randolph and surrounding counties since 1980
about:
Valley Steel Services, based in Beverly, West Virginia, has provided steel to Randolph County and surrounding areas since 1980. The operation sits south of Dailey, roughly 11 miles south of Elkins, and serves customers throughout the region.

The company stocks carbon steel, aluminum, and stainless steel in forms such as sheet, plate, flats, channels, angles, and beams. It also supplies galvanized and type‑S HDPE culvert, welding gases, and a line of blade steels. Beyond material sales, Valley Steel runs a fabrication shop equipped with a Starlab plasma CNC table for precision cutting, and offers local delivery to job sites.

Its customer base includes local contractors, farmers, manufacturers, and hobbyists who rely on the company for structural steel, piping, and custom‑fabricated parts for construction, agricultural equipment, and general repair work.

The business emphasizes quick turnaround through its on‑site plasma cutting and same‑day delivery within the service area, and it maintains a niche inventory of blade steels that caters to knife makers and tool shops.

name: Value Plus Auto Parts Wholesale
old_description: A Trusted Wholesale Auto Parts Supplier Serving Southeast Michigan Since 1997
about:
Value Plus Auto Parts Wholesale operates from two locations in the Detroit metro area — Westland and Detroit, Michigan — and has served Southeast Michigan since its founding in 1997. The business was established as a wholesale auto parts supplier focused on repair facilities, commercial auto businesses, and retail customers, building a reputation for dependable service and competitive pricing over more than two decades.

The company distributes a broad range of automotive components including brake parts, ignition components, engine parts, cooling system parts, suspension parts, filters, electrical components, and motor oil for both domestic and import vehicles.

Primary customers are independent repair shops, commercial fleet operators, and retail motorists throughout Southeast Michigan. The supplier also works with independent mechanics and automotive service centers that rely on quick access to quality parts from brands such as Bosch, Denso, Dorman, AC Delco, Timken, TRW, and Hitachi.

Value Plus differentiates itself through a mission to provide quality parts at the most competitive prices by leveraging a network of small businesses that negotiate collectively with vendors. Its promise emphasizes availability, service programs for both retail and repair facilities, and a commitment to longevity through prosperity, backed by knowledgeable staff and a professional, organized operation.

name: VanTran Transformers
old_description: Custom distribution-class transformer manufacturer headquartered and manufacturing in Waco, Texas, now part of the Forgent power infrastructure group.
about:
VanTran Transformers was founded in 1963 in Vandalia, Illinois, and relocated to Waco, Texas in 1974, where it remains headquartered and operates its manufacturing facility. The company is now part of the Forgent power infrastructure group, which combines VanTran with MGM Transformers, States Manufacturing, and PwrQ to deliver end-to-end power solutions.

VanTran designs and manufactures custom distribution-class transformers, including padmount, substation, multi-tap substation, auto-transformers, submersible and vault, grounding, polemount, and dry medium-voltage units (VPI and cast resin). Its capabilities span custom engineering, retrofit design solutions, and in-house manufacturing, supported by a workforce of 51 to 200 employees.

The company serves industrial, oil and gas, petrochemical, utility, data center, rental power, renewable energy, mining, and transit markets. Customers include data centers, manufacturing facilities, and power-grid operators requiring short delivery cycles and on-time delivery for critical infrastructure projects.

VanTran emphasizes timely, customizable, liquid-filled distribution transformers with what it describes as the shortest lead times in the industry. The firm has been recognized on the Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing U.S. companies, citing exponential growth that enables expanded client support while maintaining high-quality standards.

name: Vanguard Manufacturing Inc.
old_description: Vanguard Manufacturing joined the Lyn-Lad Group in 1970, after being acquired by Lynn Ladder’s founder, Bernard “Bernie” Kline.
about:
Vanguard Manufacturing operates from a 101,100-square-foot facility on nine acres in New Ipswich, New Hampshire. The company became part of the Lyn-Lad Group in 1970 when Lynn Ladder founder Bernard "Bernie" Kline acquired it, and it remains family owned and operated today.

The company manufactures a full line of steel frame scaffolding, fixed steel access ladders, steel roof ladders, a proprietary chimney bracket scaffold, aluminum planks and stages, and rugged truck and van racks. Since the late 1970s it has applied an electrostatic powder coat finish that became an industry standard for durability. In addition to manufacturing, Vanguard runs an extensive rental division that supplies frame scaffold, planks, and Hydro Mobile mast climbers to job sites across the country. Custom fabrication is offered with short lead times because production is kept in house.

Primary customers are commercial and industrial contractors in the construction, maintenance, and industrial access sectors. The rental fleet serves the same end users, providing temporary access solutions for projects that range from building facades to chimney repairs.

Vanguard emphasizes domestic production, stating that all products are made in the USA. The combination of a family ownership structure, a woman owned certification, and the ability to produce custom sizes quickly is presented as the core differentiator in a market where many competitors rely on imported components.

name: Vapor Apparel
old_description: Free Sarong or Wrap on orders $60 or more. Add to cart - no code needed.
about:
Vapor Apparel is based in Hanahan, South Carolina, and was founded in 2008. The company operates as a manufacturer of sun-protective performance apparel.

The company produces a range of UPF 50+ rated shirts, hoodies, base layers, and midweight polos for men and women. Its product lines include the Solar series, midweight fabrics designed for layering, and a print shop offering custom graphics on stock garments. Vapor Apparel also runs a wholesale division supplying retailers and bulk buyers.

The brand targets outdoor enthusiasts in fishing, hunting, coastal, and general sun-protection markets. Its wholesale channel serves retailers and promotional-product distributors, while the print shop caters to organizations seeking custom-branded sun-protective wear.

Vapor Apparel emphasizes its proprietary SolarBloc® technology, which provides permanent UPF 50+ protection combined with moisture-wicking and stretch properties. The company also highlights a partnership with the Skin Cancer Foundation, underscoring its focus on sun safety.
